plugins.name: fly
plugins.description: Ship the current work as a pull request with every local check green — reads the repo's CHECKS.md, runs the checks, fixes what breaks, commits, pushes, and opens or updates the PR. Does not wait on CI.

plugins.name: shape-it
plugins.description: Plan a piece of work by reading the project first, saying in plain words what it is and what skipping it costs, then asking only what is expensive to reverse. Batched multiple-choice questions only when a fork passes the bar, then a markdown plan — a file, or the task in a Zumino-tracked repo — printed in full, ending with one what-next question. `shape-it` reads and writes DOMAIN.md and docs/decisions/ so answers outlive the plan; `shape-it-lite` is the same procedure without them, for repos that carry neither. Ships `domain` and the manual-only `domain-adopt`. Does not enter plan mode; implements only when chosen at the end.

plugins.name: huddle
plugins.description: Ask questions as a page in an agterm HTML overlay instead of AskUserQuestion: visual options, diagrams, charts, sliders with a live preview, several questions with a review, keyboard throughout. Needs agterm 0.34 or later.
